description.value: You look like a mangy, lice-ridden opossum that happens to walk on its hind legs. Actual opossums, on the rare occasions they're asked about this, are offended by the comparison. Some grimples have wide flaps of skin between their limbs that allow them to fly (with the Gremlin Flight feat). You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Gremlin Lice] reaction.
